actions.name: make_request_v2
actions.title: Send request
actions.help: Send an HTTP request to an API endpoint. Do not hard-code sensitive data like token , username/password and client ID/secret into input fields. Include them in your connection or use account properties. Check out the recommended security best practices for your recipe.

input.name: request_name
input.label: Request name
input.hint: Used for generating the Workato action title, e.g. Create ticket

properties.name: url
properties.label: Request URL
properties.hint: Provide an absolute URL or relative URL (if Base URL is configured in connection).

properties.name: content_type
properties.label: Request content type
properties.hint: The API endpoint documentation should define what data it expects

properties.name: body
properties.label: Request body

properties.hint: HTTP request body to send with the request. Learn more

input.name: wait_for_response
input.label: Wait for response
input.hint: When set to yes , this action will wait for the request to complete for up to 1 hour but doesn’t guarantee ordering of job execution. Use this when your HTTP requests have frequent timeouts or are exp…

input.name: completion_threshold_seconds
input.label: Response timeout (seconds)
input.hint: Set the maximum time (in seconds) Workato will wait for a response. If no response is received within this window, the job will fail. Must be an integer between 11 and 3600 seconds. Defaults to 3600.

input.label: Disable retries
input.hint: When set to yes , automatic retries for failed requests will be disabled. By default, HTTP GET, HEAD, PUT, DELETE, OPTIONS, and TRACE requests are automatically retried once on certain network errors.…
